scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @novel-studio/contracts && npm run build -w @novel-studio/storage
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @novel-studio/server && npm run build -w @novel-studio/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
